text: We all have stuff we don’t use anymore. Maybe you got a new lamp, and the old one’s just sitting there. For you, it’s taking up space. For someone else, it could be exactly what they need.
Giving it away should be simple. Less waste. One less thing to buy. But posting is only the beginning. There’s still a pickup to arrange.
Post what you’re giving away. Or ask for what you need.
Say someone needs a lamp, and you have one.
With just a photo, Gemini drafts the listing and finds their request. You check the details, correct the condition, and approve it. Gemini does the drafting. You make the decision.
They accept and get a four-digit pickup code.
Then Loop joins the conversation. It asks you first, because you’re the one giving. Just tell Loop when and where: “Tomorrow at noon, Davis Library.” The other person confirms. Loop reminds you both.
At pickup, they show you the code. You enter it. Done. No personal details to exchange. Even when you meet. All you need is the code.

And the whole thing works in Messages. Through Photon’s Spectrum, Loop has its own iMessage number. Text it a photo. Give the draft a thumbs-up. Text a time. Enter the code at pickup. No app needed. And your phone number stays private.
Have a whole pile of stuff? Gemini can turn a single photo into separate listings and see who might need them. You review the drafts, just like before.
From one lamp to a whole pile, the idea stays the same: make the process simpler, so we waste less and make it easier for people in the community to help each other out.
